title: zannichellia palustris subsp. major
intro: Zannichellia palustris subsp. major, commonly known as the Greater Hornwort, is a subspecies of aquatic plant that belongs to the family Zannichelliaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal disorders, due to its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Zannichellia palustris subsp. major include reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and modulating the immune system, which may contribute to its use in treating conditions like bronchitis and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been the subject of ongoing research.
